title: Bleeding — खून बहना
warning: Heavy bleeding that does not stop after 10 minutes of pressure needs emergency care.

steps.instruction: Wear gloves if available. Apply firm direct pressure to wound with clean cloth.
steps.hint: If no gloves, use multiple layers of cloth as barrier

steps.instruction: Press firmly and continuously for at least 10 minutes. Do NOT lift cloth to check.
steps.hint: Lifting the cloth disrupts clot formation

steps.instruction: If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top — do not remove original cloth.
Raise the injured limb above heart level if possible.
steps.hint: Gravity reduces blood flow to the wound

steps.instruction: For deep cuts or wounds that do not stop bleeding: go to hospital.
For internal bleeding (bruising, swollen abdomen, coughing blood): call 108 immediately.
steps.hint: Internal bleeding is not visible but life-threatening

steps.instruction: Keep person warm and calm. Lay them down if dizzy or pale.
